gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-ysabeau-office: Modern Ysabeau Office leaves every curve open-ended, while Comic Relief up top draws its letters with one thread of ink. Loud shapes above, lighter ones below, and the page holds together.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-zalando-sans: Comic Relief draws every line with a single uniform stroke width. Zalando Sans has open-ended curves and an approachable manner, so whole paragraphs of text read smoothly without snagging anywhere.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-zalando-sans-expa: Commanding Comic Relief ends each stroke as wide as its middle, with bowls left unfinished on one side. Zalando Sans Expanded brings the clean, sparse spacing, its c tips staying well apart.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-zalando-sans-semi: Comic Relief draws each glyph as if with one pen tip, simple and commanding. And Zalando Sans SemiExpanded sits below in modern, open-mouthed curves, quiet enough to let the heading talk.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-zcool-xiaowei: Heavy diagonals, open-sided bowls, no fuss: Comic Relief hits hard. ZCOOL XiaoWei offers a gentle weight shift and no ink pooling at the turns, its thick strokes leading the eye without dominating.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-zen-kaku-gothic-a: Comic Relief hits hard with thick, uniform strokes and half-open bowls. Zen Kaku Gothic Antique has the quieter talent, carrying the eye smoothly around each bend, its t crossbar matching the stem.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-zen-kaku-gothic-n: Comic Relief leaves its bowls unfinished on one side, and its upstrokes look no different from its sidestrokes. Zen Kaku Gothic New has no hairlines, no swells, only clear curves.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-zen-maru-gothic: Comic Relief leaves each bowl open on one side and draws sideways strokes just like upward ones. Zen Maru Gothic reads like following a single thread, never snagging on a closed-up bowl.
gen-gf-comic-relief-ibm-plex-sans: IBM Plex Sans opens a wide channel into every bowl, technical in feel yet approachable. And long paragraphs in it move along without friction, while Comic Relief holds a steady drafting-pen line.
gen-gf-comic-relief-zilla-slab: Sturdy Zilla Slab anchors the text with broad openings on every curve, under a Comic Relief heading with zero stroke contrast. Bare strokes above, slab feet below, and each keeps its own job.
